judge.answer_key: Run validity: valid kit run (primary, psql, both customer databases; cloudsqladmin is provider-internal and doesn't need a file), so G0.2 goes to Needs approval with the kit files as evidence; the operations describe output is missing, so G0.3 stays open with a follow-up. Blocker: 6d child column metrics_2026_q3.recorded_at lacks the parent NOT NULL, which pg_upgrade 18 refuses; count nulls, then SET NOT NULL. Prework: 6g normalize_tags(text[]) used by idx_orders_tags_norm; btree_gist exclusion excl_price_windows to check against the 14.24 notes; vendor_settings has no PK (only matters for logical paths). CDC: search_feed uses decoderbufs, which output_plugin_libraries refuses unless allowed and which must exist on the target; old_migration_test is inactive with about 96 GB retained WAL, so find its owner or drop it; every slot is deleted by the upgrade. Replica list includes shop-pg16-test, which looks stale. Provider precheck shows no ERRORs. No gate is set to Done.
